accountRef.description: CAIP-10 style account reference, lowercase hex: eip155:<chainId>:<0x...>

ref.description: A subject or resource reference string (CAIP-2/10/19, did:, urn: or a framework-specific reference).

identifier.description: Profile or vocabulary identifier: asf:<class>:<name>@<version> or x:<namespace>:<name>@<version>

protectedDomain.description: What is protected: assets and economic positions; information and privacy; control and rules (accounts, infrastructure, rule-making power, the controls themselves); credit and eligibility; the rights and welfare of persons, society and the public (the principal included).

restriction.description: One response requirement; several may be combined in one suspension (bit set on chain: no-new-risk 1, shrink 2, essential-only 4, derisk-only 8, full-stop 16).

kind.description: Mechanism kind, for example a proposal reference such as erc-7715, a product name or an internal identifier.

ref.description: Instance reference: contract reference, codehash, domain id, URL or document hash.

extensions.description: Extension members keyed by identifier. A member with required = true MUST be understood by consumers.

affectedRole.description: Role of an affected party relative to the delegation: the principal on whose behalf the subject acts, the operator running it, a counterparty of its actions, a bystander, or the public.
